display_name: Nori 1.5 CI fixture (random init, schema v2)
_note: Random-init Nori 1.5 (Model v3, two-phase encoder) fixture (Apache-2.0 architecture, our weights), regression only, in the released checkpoint's own torch.save layout {model_config, model_state_dict, inference_config} (no EMA copy). H is DYNAMIC; y carries RAW train targets only (length = train_size). The model standardises features itself and the wrapper standardises the target in-graph, so the engine profile is *_raw. The output is ONE raw-space point estimate per row (the mean of the quantile head); rows < S are in-context fitted values (context rows presented a second time as queries).
